apps.note: The Worker is deployed from main by Workers Builds. Cloudflare exposes no supported API to delete individual Worker versions, and repository workflows create no Worker previews. If the Worker adopts Worker Previews, add a supported deletion mechanism before relying on this policy. Issue #14 uses temporary standalone Workers woodbrook-mobile-sanity-14, woodbrook-mobile-ui-14 and woodbrook-mobile-handoff-14 for review. They are not covered by Pages deployment deletion; refresh or manually remove them after seven days.
